svg.text: Effective marginal rate on £200 more pay, 2026-27
Income tax + NICs + HICBC, less Child Benefit, UC and Tax-Free Childcare; above 100% the extra £200 leaves the household worse off
Lone parent, 1 child: UC (no childcare element) or Tax-Free Childcare
Lone parent, 3 children (2 in childcare): UC (no childcare element) or Tax-Free Childcare
